confirmed_device_reference.owner_exact_flash_variant: unknown; owner report omits suffix after SC
confirmed_device_reference.wireless: BLE 5.4, LE 1M/2M PHY, proprietary 2.4 GHz FSK
confirmed_device_reference.adc: 12-bit SAR; generic ADC availability is not a completed audio subsystem
confirmed_device_reference.adc_rate_caveat: Front-page 800kHz claim and section 4.10 manual-mode maximum 320kHz differ; no unconditional unified maximum adopted.
confirmed_device_reference.i2s_caveat: Only glossary occurrence observed; no I2S peripheral support established by block diagram, peripheral chapters or address map.

unsupported_inferences: BLE 5.4 by itself establishes LE Audio or ISO support.
Private GATT FF12/FFF2/FFF3 is A2DP or HFP.
A2DP Sink can substitute for A2DP Source when sending radio audio to a headset.
A glossary I2S entry proves an implemented I2S peripheral.
A 6-byte metadata field necessarily represents a Bluetooth address.
115200 is the PHY6235 hardware UART limit.
MCU ADC presence proves routing of all BK4829/Si4732/BK1080 receiver audio.
8 KB SRAM alone proves all LC3 implementations mathematically impossible.
remaining_evidence_gaps: PHY6235SC internal firmware and compatible SDK.
Controller ISO/CIS support and audio profile roles.
PCB wiring, supply, reset, UART and ADC signal source.
Real BLE throughput, audio quality, latency and headset interoperability.
scope: Device reference and feasibility research, no firmware audio implementation or hardware validation.
